assumptions: primer3's and TaqMan's published constraints define an acceptable assay.
Melting temperatures are the nearest-neighbour model's at the stated conditions.
limits: No upstream designs this triple, so every cited primer3 and TaqMan constraint is asserted on the designed assays instead.
Specificity is whether both primers bind a single site in the sequence given, not in a genome.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which primer pair and hydrolysis probe make a qPCR assay on this target, ranked by penalty?

description: Design qPCR assays over the subject — primer pair plus hydrolysis probe, ranked by penalty, with amplicon size/GC, per-oligo Tm and whether both primers bind a single site.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

amplicon_max.description: longest acceptable amplicon - qPCR amplicons are short on purpose, because a short product amplifies efficiently enough for the exponential phase to be clean. In bp.

conditions.description: salt, magnesium, dNTP and oligo concentrations plus the salt-correction method and any DMSO or formamide that every Tm in this design is measured in. Left unset it is filled from your reaction-conditions settings, and falls back to the nearest-neighbour defaults when there are none. Advanced.

additives.description: DMSO and formamide, applied AFTER the nearest-neighbour Tm.

DMSOfactor.description: °C of Tm lost per % DMSO, as an explicit override. Supplying it WINS over `dmsoMethod`, and detaches the number from its citation.

dmsoMethod.description: which published DMSO depression sets the coefficient. Values: ahs01 (Ahsen et al. (2001) (0.75 °C per %)), mus81 (Musielski et al. (1981) (0.6 °C per %)), cul76 (Cullen and Bick (1976) (0.5 °C per %)), esc80 (Escara and Hutton (1980) (0.675 °C per %)).

fmd.description: formamide — percent when `fmdmethod` is 1, molar when it is 2.

fmdfactor.description: °C lost per % formamide (method 1). Papers report 0.6 to 0.72.

fmdmethod.description: 1 = linear % formamide (McConaughy 1969) · 2 = GC-dependent, molar (Blake & Delcourt 1996). Values: 1 (Linear %, McConaughy 1969), 2 (GC-dependent molar, Blake & Delcourt 1996).

method.description: which validated nearest-neighbour model and default buffer — santaLucia (pydna `tm_default`, Taq) or dbd (pydna `tm_dbd`, Phusion / Pfu-Sso7d). Values: santaLucia (SantaLucia (pydna tm_default, Taq)), dbd (DNA-binding domain (pydna tm_dbd, Phusion)).

nnTable.description: override the method's nearest-neighbour table; the buffer convention is unchanged.

saltcorr.description: Biopython salt-correction method 0–7 (0 = none). It moves the answer more than any other knob here: on a 24-mer at the Taq buffer the eight span 79.302 °C (method 0) to 66.009 °C (method 2).

selfcomp.description: both strands are one self-complementary oligo (the concentration term becomes dnac1 rather than dnac1 − dnac2/2).

max_poly_x.description: longest run of one base allowed in any oligo (primer3's POLY_X). A long run mispairs by slipping, and for a TaqMan probe a run of four or more Gs quenches the reporter. In nt. Advanced.

max_results.description: how many assays to return, best penalty first.

primer_max_gc.description: highest acceptable primer GC content. In %. Advanced.

primer_max_length.description: longest primer considered; primer3's own ceiling is 36. In nt. Advanced.

primer_max_tm.description: primers above this Tm are rejected outright. In °C. Advanced.

primer_min_gc.description: lowest acceptable primer GC content. In %. Advanced.

primer_min_length.description: shortest primer considered. In nt. Advanced.

primer_min_tm.description: primers below this Tm are rejected outright, not merely penalised. In °C. Advanced.

primer_opt_length.description: primer length the penalty prefers. In nt. Advanced.

primer_tm_opt.description: target primer Tm; the penalty ranks candidates by their distance from it. In °C.

probe_chemistry.description: what the hydrolysis probe is made of. `dna` is unmodified DNA; `lna` locks the bases named by `probe_locked_positions`, which raises the probe Tm and is how a short probe reaches the TaqMan offset over its primers. MGB and Scorpion chemistries are not offered: neither has a published nearest-neighbour parameter set to compute a Tm from.

probe_locked_positions.description: which bases to lock, 1-based from the probe's 5′ end, e.g. `3, 6, 9`. Read only when `probe_chemistry` is `lna`. Positions must be interior to the SHORTEST probe the search will try and never adjacent, because McTigue et al. (2004) measured one locked base per nearest neighbour and none at a duplex end - a position that breaks either rule is refused by name rather than silently dropped. Only applies when probe_chemistry is lna.

probe_max_gc.description: highest acceptable probe GC content. In %. Advanced.

probe_max_length.description: longest probe considered. In nt. Advanced.

probe_max_tm.description: probes above this Tm are rejected outright. In °C. Advanced.

probe_min_gc.description: lowest acceptable probe GC content. In %. Advanced.

probe_min_length.description: shortest probe considered. In nt. Advanced.

probe_min_tm.description: probes below this Tm are rejected outright. In °C. Advanced.

probe_opt_length.description: probe length the penalty prefers. In nt. Advanced.

probe_tm_offset_min.description: how many °C the probe Tm must exceed the MEAN primer Tm. TaqMan guidance is 8-10; below that the probe can melt off before it is cleaved. In °C.

probe_tm_opt.description: target probe Tm - conventionally ~10 °C above the primers, so the probe is bound before extension reaches it. In °C.

region_end.description: 0-based inclusive end. Unset = the whole sequence. Advanced.

region_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the region to design in. Unset = the whole sequence; pass the selection's start to scope to it. Advanced.

structure_check.description: run the `thal` secondary-structure check on the RETURNED assays: hairpin and cross-dimer melting temperatures for all three oligos and every pairing between them. On by default, because a qPCR assay that dimerises is the commonest design failure and penalty ranking alone will happily put one first. Off returns null structures and is measurably faster - the check is a dynamic-programming alignment per oligo pair. Advanced.

name: design_qpcr_assay

conditions.description: the buffer every Tm in this design was measured in - salt, magnesium, dNTPs, oligo concentration, the salt-correction method and any additives - or a note saying none were supplied

offset.description: where the designed-in stretch starts in the record: add it to every position above for record coordinates. 0 unless a region was given

probe_ordered.description: the best assay's probe as it must be ORDERED: plain DNA, or the locked-base notation (`GTCGLAAC`) when the probe was designed as LNA
